name: gravekeeper
description: Walks the graveyard of your docs once a week. Gravekeeper asks the public Lychgate scanner to check the Markdown links of the public repos you watch, keeps the history, and writes a short report with Wayback snapshots and a ready PR description when a repo's health drops or a new dead link appears. It only reports; it never opens pull requests.
author: Demir (demir-sama)
highlights: Weekly walk over up to 10 public repos, spaced to respect Lychgate's rate limit
Health trend and latest shared Lychgate report for each repo on one dashboard page
New Tombstones, Ghosts and Zombies come with Wayback snapshots and a PR description you can paste
Read-only: no pull requests, comments or writes to watched repos
useCases: When you maintain open-source docs, find out each Monday which links died since last week
When a release is coming, open the dashboard to see whether docs health fell
When you fix dead links, paste the ready PR description instead of writing one
configuration: Edit watchlist.json in the app folder: list public repos as "owner/repo" (at most 10)
Enable the app; the walk runs by itself on Mondays at 09:00 UTC (no model, no approvals). Ask the Gravekeeper agent what the last walk found
